notes: Independent 36-month runs per side, same Standard archives, trade on and raids off.
Food quantities are actual staple-ledger settlements converted with WAIN_KG, not all nutrition.
Positive gaps are summed per market and settlement; aggregate supplied may slightly exceed need due to ledger rounding.
Twelve-event intervals count actual 30-day settlement steps, not calendar-month names.
Recorded footprint uses authored stocking densities and rural herds in inhabited cells. Land sums cover all plan cells. Neither is a historical adequacy finding.
Annual planning closes 25% of each gap per update; cold start includes an update for the starting calendar year. Thirty-six months do not prove convergence.
